Hakeem S. JeffriesDemocratic · U.S. Representative; House Democratic Leader
Top U.S. voter concern

Health Care

Health insurance, costs and access to care.

  • ✓Supports making life-saving medical care affordable
“No one should have to make a decision between accessing life-saving medical care and putting food on the table.”
Source: Healthcare – Congressman Hakeem Jeffries (official U.S. House website)

What this means for youHe would vote to lower out-of-pocket medical costs. As Democratic Leader he also shapes which health bills his party pushes.

Top U.S. voter concern

Income and Wealth Gap

How income and wealth are distributed, including taxes and wages.

  • ✓Supports the PRO Act, protecting workers' right to organize
  • ✓Supports ending pay discrimination against women
“I have worked with my House colleagues to introduce the Richard L. Trumka Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, landmark legislation that will protect the essential right of workers to organize for better working conditions.”
Source: Economy and Workforce – Congressman Hakeem Jeffries (official U.S. House website)

What this means for youThe PRO Act would make it easier for workers to form unions. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

Crime

  • ✓Supports sentencing reform, including retroactive relief for crack cocaine sentences
